items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Peggy Lee was doing with Benny Goodman and, you know, makin' a fortune.

ctx.x: What did you spend the money on?

The room and food. That's all. Reeds. Music, you know. I met, one day, I met Vido Musso. Benny Goodman was in town and...he was a nice fellow...and we was talkin' about mouthpieces and sound and whatnot and then, another day, at this music store, I met Roy Eldridge in there. Hehheh.
